narr: Storms moved across southwest Wisconsin during the early morning hours of August 8th. These storms produced heavy rainfall with radar estimates of 2 to 2.5 inches. Runoff from this heavy rain caused some rock slides to occur near Potosi (Grant County). A few culverts became clogged with debris, sending water over State Highway 133.
